關於圖書館空間預約系統出現 API error 訊息  About API error message in library's space booking system.

部份讀者使用圖書館空間預約系統時，若出現API error的訊息，可以改用無痕視窗測試，若無痕視窗開啟不會出現API錯誤訊息，建議你刪除瀏覽資料，這樣應該就不會再出現API錯誤的訊息，若API錯誤訊息還是不能解決，請告知圖書館以便能及時處理，謝謝你的合作。

Some users may receive an API error message when using the library's space booking system. Please try testing in an incognito window instead. If the API error message does not appear in the incognito window, it is recommended that you delete your browsing data so that there may be no more API error messages. If the API error message still appears, please inform the library so that the library can handle it. Thank you for your cooperation.
